properties.entry: INSERT INTO users(name, email, password, role) VALUES(:name, :email, :password, :role)
SELECT* FROM users WHERE email = :email AND password = :password
INSERT INTO tickets(user_id, title, description, category, priority, status) VALUES(:userId, :title, :description, :category, :priority,'PENDING')
SELECT id,user_id, title, description, category, priority, status, comments FROM tickets
SELECT id,user_id, title, description, category, priority, status, comments FROM tickets WHERE user_id = :userId
SELECT id,user_id, title, description, category, priority, status, comments FROM tickets WHERE id =:id
UPDATE tickets set status =:status, comments = :comments WHERE id =:id
